description: Standard protocol for conformational analysis of protein NMR ensembles. Identifies the NMR ensemble from a collection of structure files, extracts structural properties, and quantifies backbone flexibility.

source_file.description: Basename of the PDB file identified as the NMR ensemble

n_models.description: Number of NMR models in the ensemble

n_residues.description: Number of amino acid residues per model

sequence.description: One-letter amino acid sequence derived from the structure

rmsd_matrix.description: Pairwise C-alpha RMSD values in Angstroms, computed after optimal rigid-body superimposition of each model pair

medoid_model.description: 0-indexed model with the minimum mean RMSD to all other models

mean_pairwise_rmsd.description: Mean of all unique pairwise RMSD values (upper triangle of the RMSD matrix)

phi_angles.description: Backbone phi dihedral angles in radians; null where geometrically undefined

psi_angles.description: Backbone psi dihedral angles in radians; null where geometrically undefined

per_residue_flexibility.description: Angular dispersion of dihedral angle distributions across models, measured as circular variance. For a set of angles theta: CV = 1 - sqrt(mean(cos(theta))^2 + mean(sin(theta))^2). Report the mean of CV(phi) and CV(psi) where both are defined for that residue, or the single available value if only one is defined. Range is [0, 1]. null where both phi and psi are undefined for a residue.

secondary_structure.description: Per-residue backbone conformation classification for the medoid model, using the Ramachandran region definitions below

ramachandran_regions.note: Classify each residue of the medoid model based on its phi and psi angles, converted to degrees

coil.condition: All other cases, including residues where phi or psi is undefined
